expect: organic coating ~3.3 wt% at ~350 °C, carbon black ~4.1 wt% at ~550 °C (p6.L6-7); calcination in air at 600 °C (for 2 h, p3.L21)
question: What two components does the TGA show being burned off the recovered NMC622, how much of each and at what temperature, and what calcination removes both?
rendered: The TGA-DTG data in Figure 4a of the document show that the organic coating layer (~3.3 wt%) and carbon black (~4.1 wt%) are burned off the recovered NMC622. The organic coating layer is burned off at ~350 °C, and carbon black is burned off at ~550 °C. Calcination in air at 600 °C removes both the organic coating layer and carbon black.
